thread:
deploy-bot: Canary promotion attempt for service=feature-api tag=v1.14.0 failed pre-promote integration test step: 3/12 tests failed (timeout/seed-collision). Promotion held automatically.

alex: seeing the canary hold in the release window. quick glance at test failures shows two different flakes: one db-seed timed out, one flaky auth integration. logs attached in CI run 98765.

priya: ugh, those auth flakes have been intermittent since yesterday's infra change. did we roll any network policy tweaks to staging?

tomo: yes we rolled ingress-policy v2 last night. I saw increased conn closed logs. could be related to the auth integration hitting a backend pod that was restarting.

qa-lead: the integration suite is ~18m total. non-deterministic flakes kill the promote. options: 1) pin canary to v1.13.9 to keep the window moving, 2) rerun the canary after fixing or widening timeouts, or 3) skip canary and push straight to prod (not ideal).

release-manager: we have a 45m change window. prefer minimal blast radius. recommend pin to last-good (v1.13.9) and schedule a follow-up to triage the flaky auth test and ingress-policy interaction. Agree?

alex: curious if a simple rerun succeeds — but rerun under the same infra might flip the same flakes. i vote pin and investigate.

priya: if we pin, can we still let other independent services promote? we should avoid a global pause.

deploy-bot: Usage: `deploybot pin --service feature-api --image v1.13.9 --reason "canary integration flake v1.14.0"`

alex: running pin now:
```bash
deploybot pin --service feature-api --image v1.13.9 --reason "canary integration flake v1.14.0"
```

deploy-bot: Pin successful. Canary rollback to v1.13.9 and stable routes restored.

release-manager: adding to release notes: "Canary for feature-api v1.14.0 held due to integration test flakes; pinned to v1.13.9 to maintain SLAs. Investigation ticket CI-1901 opened."

qa-lead: created CI-1901: "feature-api canary flakes after ingress-policy v2 rollout; reproduce and harden tests". Assigning @priya and @tomo. Steps to reproduce and logs in ticket.

priya: immediate fix plan:
- repro in staging via test harness with repeated seeds
- add short retry for auth integration (2 retries) and increase DB seed timeout from 20s -> 40s while we triage root cause
- run a targeted canary rerun in 1h with these mitigations

tomo: infra follow-ups: revert ingress-policy tweak if staging repro shows restarts, or add liveness probe tuning. will monitor pod restarts and link metrics to CI-1901.

sre-oncall: creating incident INC-2026-042 to monitor staging pod restarts and network policy 503s. will correlate with CI runs.

release-manager: decision: keep change window open for 1h, but block feature-api v1.14.0 promotes until CI-1901 triage completes. other services can continue promoting. retrospective: add a pre-promote quick smoke that repeats flaky tests x3 to reduce transient flake impact.

alex: noted. i'll add a short retry harness in the integration stage and queue the rerun. will post back once rerun completes.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion status: held -> pinned -> stable (pinned v1.13.9).

release-manager: closing thread: pin applied to maintain release cadence; CI-1901/INC-2026-042 tracking remediation and postmortem. :white_check_mark:
